subject: rocket
name: 火箭
label: 圆窗小火箭
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One upright toy rocket with rounded pointed nose, one big round window and two side fins, no fire.
Pure black contour line art with smooth blank interiors. No dense repeated texture, no hatching, no shading or gray tonal fills. Clear surrounding margins and complete silhouette.
